name: Cheesemaker Sian

intro.text: Cheddar from a coal mine! You'd think it would taste of coal. It tastes of cheddar. Magnificent cheddar. Battle?

win: That was a bit of a mature performance.
after: Pwll Mawr matures down Big Pit. The cool, damp air is perfect for it. They say the cheese hums when the pit ponies walk past.
